Hello!I'm Sakhi
A little about me

A producer of moments, a curator of creators.

I build campaigns that don't just trend — they convert. From sourcing the right voices to negotiating celebrity deals at half the price, I run influencer marketing end-to-end.

Based in New Delhi, I'm currently a Senior Executive at Qoruz — promoted in April 2026 from Junior Account Executive in recognition of consistently high-impact campaign delivery. Across both roles, I've managed 150+ creator partnerships, negotiated celebrity collaborations with a 50% cost reduction, and overseen full-scale production shoots with 200+ crew and talent.

My portfolio spans tech, beauty, FMCG, fashion, lifestyle and premium spirits — Realme, Vivo, OPPO, Samsung, Sensodyne, Otrivin, Hamdard, ENO, Underneat, Jack Daniel's and Woodford Reserve among them. I work where creator culture meets brand strategy.
